newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen steady, upside may be limited.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen steady, upside may be limited.

text.p: Japanese government bonds are likely to be steady on Thursday, but the upside may be capped by a stock market rise following a local media report that the MOF may protect, in time of banks' financial trouble, holders of instruments which are currently not legally protected.
A local financial daily reported that the MOF has started considering guaranteeing financial instruments which are now outside of the protection of the Deposit Insurance Corp.
"If Tokyo stocks are cheered by the report, the JGB's upside may be limited, though there are no negative factors for bonds at the moment," said a city bank trader.
